The store is a promise-queue-serialised layer over a minimal `DiagnosticRetentionStorage` (list/read/insert/remove/reset) so the eviction policy is unit-tested purely and the SQLite adapter is exercised against a REAL SQLite engine (node:sqlite via the same execute() seam op-sqlite exposes), matching the repo's existing testSupport/sqlite.ts pattern. implement.summary: Defect on BASE_SHA f250acd7: the approved JS-only diagnostics transport had no on-disk buffer at all — apps/mobile/src/diagnostics/sentry.ts:157-158 configured Sentry with `maxQueueSize: 8, maxCacheItems: 0`, sentry.ts:162-170 built `createScrubbedTransport(makeTransport(options), identity)` straight onto the fetch transport, and sentry.ts:315 hard-coded `persistentQueue: false`; scrub.ts's createScrubbedTransport swallows a failed send (returns {}), so any envelope produced while offline was silently lost, and no module in the app implemented size/age caps, eviction or corruption handling (no `retention` module existed; `Cannot find module '../retention'`). Fix (HEAD 614ab65f): new apps/mobile/src/diagnostics/retention.ts — planDiagnosticRetention (pure, deterministic policy), createBoundedDiagnosticStore (serialised async push/unshift/shift/prune over an injectable storage; scrubs before write and after read; single reset-recovery then inert), createSqliteRetentionStorage + openDiagnosticRetentionDatabase (separate op-sqlite DB `pickle-sensei-diagnostics.db`, table `diagnostic_envelope`, module loaded lazily via import() so app start never touches the native module), createRetainedTransport (online passthrough; on failure store + capped exponential retry 5s→1h + startup drain; never rejects) and createDiagnosticRetention. Hard caps: 32 envelopes / 256 KiB total / 32 KiB per envelope / 7 days (|now - storedAt|, so clock jumps in either direction evict). Wired into sentry.ts only on the approved active path; disabled/blocked gates untouched. Commits: f8025d9f + 042b96d9 (tests only, fail on base), 614ab65f (implementation + wiring). No PR opened, no push to main/ci/mac-*.
